However this is likely mitigated by a platform fact outside writing class's lane to certify: Claude Code's own default behaviour surfaces tool calls (file edits, commands) as they happen even without being told to narrate, which is a technical/behavior-class claim, not one I verified here. Flagging as a real gap against the rule's letter, not asserting the platform behaviour claim myself.
